title: erigeron glabellus subsp. pubescens
intro: Erigeron glabellus subsp. pubescens, commonly known as a type of fleabane or rough fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron glabellus subsp. pubescens are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help protect against cell damage and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
